newsitem.title: USA: Clinton "very concerned" about Peru hostages.
newsitem.headline: Clinton "very concerned" about Peru hostages.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton said on Thursday he was "very concerned" about the hostage crisis in Peru and the United States was monitoring the situation closely.
"Obviously we are keeping up with it very closely and we're very concerned about it. We're concerned about all those held hostage," Clinton told reporters.

Leftist rebels stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima Tuesday night and have been holding up to 484 people captive, including many high-ranking diplomats, businessmen and government officials.
They are demanding the release of jailed comrades and the presence of President Alberto Fujimori for talks.
Clinton said that "the Peruvian government is doing its best" and that U.S. government officials "are having communications with them."
He declined to elaborate, telling reporters during an Oval Office photo session: "I think the less any of us around the world say beyond that the better."
